parameters.content:
## START HERE: ServiceTitan CSV-Fallback Triage (DRAFT v0.3.0)
For ServiceTitan Starter and Essentials shops. Those tiers do not get a Customer-Built App Key, so there is no API to call. Export one Jobs/Dispatch report as CSV, get it into n8n, and get the SAME Morning Triage Digest and 15-minute Unassigned Aging Watch alert, both to the OWNER only.

**Test it in about 2 minutes:**
1. Import this file (done). It is inactive. The webhook, email, and schedule triggers are switched off.
2. Leave **source** = test and click **Execute workflow** on Manual Test Run. You get a [TEST] digest and a [TEST] aging alert from fictional sample data (fixtures/sample-servicetitan-export.csv).
3. Compare with sample_csv_fallback_digest.md in the pack.
4. Set source = csv, put your own export in csvFolder, run again. Still [TEST].
5. Only then enable one trigger. See the go-live note.

Status: DRAFT. Checked as importable JSON against fictional data. NOT tested against a live ServiceTitan, Gmail, or Slack account.

## Config fields
- **source**: test (built-in fictional export, default) | csv (read your export). An upload that arrives by webhook or email is always treated as csv. There is no servicetitan source in this file.
- **testMode**: ON by default. Messages are labeled [TEST]. source = test always forces it on.
- **delivery**: email | slack | both | none. Owner only.
- **ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel**: YOUR address and a private channel. Never a customer.
- **csvFolder**: watch folder for manual and scheduled runs. n8n only reads files inside its allowed folder. The Read node reads every .csv in it.
- **asOfOverride**: ISO time to pretend it is a different moment, for an export from earlier. Blank = now.
- **agingThresholdMinutes**: minutes a job may sit unassigned before it is flagged. Default 20.
- The other numbers are the same digest thresholds as the main pack.
- The scheduled run uses Config source, so set source = csv before you enable the schedule.

## Safety defaults
- Imported **inactive**. The Schedule, Webhook, and Email-attachment triggers are all **disabled**.
- **testMode** ON; source = **test**.
- **Read-only**: this file never calls ServiceTitan at all. It only reads the CSV you give it.
- **Owner-only output**: Gmail and Slack recipients come from ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel. No SMS, no Twilio, no customer email.
- The email trigger only READS an inbound message. It does not reply, label, or forward.
- The webhook expects a header-auth credential (placeholder). Never expose it without one.
- It never assigns, reassigns, or moves a job. It only flags.
- Never invents numbers. A missing report becomes a "Heads-up" line.

## CSV-Fallback (Starter / Essentials, no API key)
**Export:** in ServiceTitan, run your Jobs or Dispatch report and export to CSV. One file is enough: Aging Watch runs fully and the Morning Digest runs partially (it skips what a jobs export does not hold, with a Heads-up).
**Required columns:** Job # (or Job Number / Job ID), Status, Scheduled Start. Missing ones produce a plain-language Heads-up that names them, not a crash.
**Recognized headers (not case sensitive; spaces, underscores, hyphens treated the same):** Scheduled End, Business Unit, Job Type, Required Skill / Tag, Zone, Technician, Customer, Created On, Priority, Address, Unassigned Since, Multi-Day, and more. See the pack README for the full list. Dates like 3/10/2026 9:50 AM are read in your Config timezone.
**Three ways in:** (1) Webhook: POST the file as multipart field "data". (2) Email attachment: a CSV from an allowed sender, set in the Gmail trigger query. (3) Watch folder: drop the file in csvFolder.
**Optional extras:** technicians, capacity, memberships, estimates, and calls CSVs in the same upload or folder are used when present. File names do not matter.
Bad rows are skipped and counted in a Heads-up. Repeated job rows (one per technician) are merged.

## Credentials (placeholders only)
PLACEHOLDER_GMAIL (inbound email trigger and owner email), PLACEHOLDER_SLACK, PLACEHOLDER_WEBHOOK_HEADER_AUTH (webhook). No ServiceTitan credential is used or needed. No secrets are stored in this file.

## Hard stop before go-live
Do not turn testMode off or enable a trigger until: (1) a clean [TEST] run from the sample export, (2) a clean [TEST] run from YOUR export, spot-checked by hand against ServiceTitan, (3) ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel confirmed as owner-only, (4) the Gmail query limited to one sender you trust and the webhook behind header auth, (5) an owner has signed off in writing. Even live, this workflow only reports to the owner.
